# omada_switch_port_profile (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Omada switch port profile by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omada_switch_port_profile" "all" {
  name = "All"
}

output "all_profile_id" {
  value = data.omada_switch_port_profile.all.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Profile ID lookup selector and result.
- `name` (String) Profile name lookup selector and result.
- `site_id` (String) Site ID. Defaults to the provider site.

### Read-Only

- `native_network_id` (String) Native/untagged VLAN network ID.
- `network_tags_setting` (Number) VLAN tag policy: 0 Allow All, 1 Block All, or 2 Custom.
- `tagged_network_ids` (Set of String) Tagged VLAN network IDs.
- `untagged_network_ids` (Set of String) Additional untagged VLAN network IDs.
- `vlan_config_enable` (Boolean) Whether profile VLAN configuration is enabled.
